settings.heading: Picked one by one
settings.text: Everything here is chosen by hand. If it isn't something I'd actually wear or put on my own wall, it doesn't go in the shop.

settings.heading: Checked before it ships
settings.text: Sizes, materials and photos are checked against the real thing, so what turns up is what you thought you were buying.

settings.heading: Posted quickly
settings.text: Packed and sent as fast as I can manage. Free UK shipping over £35, and 30 days to change your mind.

settings.heading: It started with one very silly duck
settings.text:
A duck in a bucket hat. A duck holding a glass of wine. A duck making a gesture that is frankly uncalled for. Once you notice how many ridiculous ducks exist in the world, it is difficult to stop collecting them.

So the shop starts with ducks, and grows one category at a time — mushrooms, frogs, snails and whatever else turns out to be worth it.
The sticker quality is genuinely absurd. Mine has been through the dishwasher on a water bottle and has not budged.
settings.author: Rosie

settings.text: Bought the duck print as a gift and immediately had to order a second one for myself. Entirely predictable.
settings.author: Alex

settings.text: Arrived in three days wrapped like a little present. The frog keyring lives on my keys now and I check on it.
settings.author: Mina

settings.question: How quickly do you post?
settings.answer: Orders are packed and sent as quickly as I can manage. Free UK shipping over £35, and international shipping is calculated at checkout.

settings.question: What sizes do the hats come in?
settings.answer: Most bucket hats are a 56–58cm one-size fit. Where a product has several sizes, they're listed on its own page — measure around your head just above the ears and go by that.

settings.question: Can I return something?
settings.answer: Yes — within 30 days, unworn and in its original packaging. Message me first and I'll sort it out.

settings.question: When are the other categories coming?
settings.answer: Ducks are stocked now. Mushrooms, frogs and the rest are being added as I find things worth stocking — the newsletter is the fastest way to hear when one lands.

settings.question: Can I request a creature?
settings.answer: Please do. If there's something you want to see in the shop, tell me and I'll go looking.
